headline: Long run delivered in full — 2h49, 1058m D+, both race-effort blocks executed
summary: Session went essentially to plan: 2h49 moving, 1058m D+ vs the prescribed ~1050m, average HR 149 sitting right in the Z2-Z3 window for the bulk of the run, and the interval log shows the 2x(climb+descent) structure intact — two blocks around 160bpm with a hard finishing push to 177 max. RPE 8 / feel "2" is a legitimately tough but appropriate cost for a 1050m vert long run with race-effort work baked in, especially stacked on short sleep this week. No pain or knee signal flagged in the data, so no walk-the-descents trigger today. Cadence sat ~84spm overall; can't isolate the descent-specific 172+ spm target from the summary, worth a quick gut-check with Alberto on how the descents actually felt underfoot. Load posted as 166 in intervals.icu against an estimated 185 — within normal variance for a HR-based long run with sustained climbing, not the short-interval undercount pattern.
flags: CTL jumped 51.8 -> 54.5 in one day (ramp rate still only +1.4/wk trailing, so no guardrail breach, but this was a big single-day hit — worth watching cumulative ramp into Wk7's loaded Tue-Thu).

This is the second week running where easy/shakeout days (Fri 30 vs 70 planned, Sat 51 solid but short) are coming in light while the long run and quality sessions over-deliver — same grey-zone pattern flagged on Oct 18 and Oct 23. Not a problem today but worth naming before Wk7's back-to-back weekend.
suggestedChange: Confirm with Alberto whether descent form (172+ spm target) actually held on the two race-effort descents — if cadence lagged, worth a short cue/drill before Wk7's back-to-back (Sat31/Sun1) rather than assuming it's locked in from today's session.
